QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Dark Lord
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to go say hello to #b#p411##k, the hidden leader of the city. I'm a bit scared to say hello to #p411# for the first time.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I was able to say hello to #p411#, the hidden leader of #m10003000#, for the first time. I felt completely overwhelmed by his presence.

0.0: "I think I can now introduce you to #p411#, since you've become a proper resident of this city. Steel yourself... and go greet #p411# in the basement of the city's jazz cafe. Good luck.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: It's been quite a while since #p425# sent someone to me. No need to be so tense. If you're a resident of this city, you're as good as a comrade to me. Live and let live, each in our own way—that's the rule of this city.
1.1: Even if everyone seems to live as they please, the people of this city value others' ways of life just as much as their own. That's the invisible force that binds the people of this city together.
1.2: #h0#, I hope you keep that in mind as well. Now, a bit late, but let me welcome you. Welcome to #m10003000#.

level.0: Do you truly believe you have earned the right to address me with such a pathetic level?
